log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Charizard

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolve Charizard into Charizard-Y. Charizard-Y/Venusaur immediately forces Maushold redirection decisions while threatening Heat Wave and fast Sleep Powder or Solar Beam into Basculegion. Goodra-Hisui is the durable Mega Floette answer and Primarina remains insurance versus Floette, Dragapult, and Hisui Arcanine once sun is no longer essential.

Intended Mega: Floette. Bench Arc+Bascu (G1 sun/Scarf/sleep fails). Lead Floette+Maushold: T1 Follow Me protects Mega Floette LoR/Moonblast vs Chomp/Goodra/Zard while Friend Guard softens spreads. Back Pult+Ape: Scarf Pult cleans or U-turns; Ape late Rage Fist after chip. Coherent anti-Dragon/sun mode.

Mega Y establishes sun and doubles Venusaur’s Speed via Chlorophyll. Heat Wave bypasses Follow Me, pressures both foes, and is a guaranteed Maushold KO; Sludge Bomb guarantees Floette’s KO if redirection is absent. This punishes Follow Me while retaining immediate Floette removal when Maushold Protects.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard to support Mega Floette or Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion. Maushold has Sitrus Berry and can use Tidy Up. Basculegion has Aqua Jet. Mega Floette has Fairy Aura and Light of Ruin recoil. Charizard-Y sun plus Venusaur Chlorophyll creates strong anti-redirection pressure; retain Primarina as Floette insurance when possible.

decisions.rationale: Sun comes up on Mega Y; Protect+Follow Me blocks Sleep/Sludge/Heat Wave turn 1, keeps both healthy, Friend Guard softens spreads. Floette outspeeds base Zard and can punish next.

Maushold dead; bring Scarf Pult into sun duo. Flamethrower pressures Venu; Infiltrator/U-turn flexible. Ape Fighting moves resisted by both foes and slower into Chlorophyll. Floette stays to threaten after chip.

Protect prevents Dragapult from freely removing Charizard while Venusaur’s Life Orb Sludge Bomb has a guaranteed Floette KO if it does not land its reduced-success Protect. Even if Dragapult moves first and Flamethrowers Venusaur, preserving Charizard keeps sun pressure and Primarina remains the Floette/Dragapult endgame backup.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard to support Mega Floette or Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion. Basculegion has Aqua Jet. Mega Floette has Fairy Aura and Light of Ruin recoil. Charizard-Y sun plus Venusaur Chlorophyll creates strong anti-redirection pressure; retain Primarina as Floette insurance when possible.

decisions.rationale: Primarina takes Dragapult's Choice-locked Flamethrower resistively and preserves immediate Moonblast pressure on Dragapult. Floette is at poison KO range, while Primarina is the stronger reserve into Basculegion and remains valuable against future Fairy pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard to support Mega Floette or Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion. Basculegion has Aqua Jet. Mega Floette has Fairy Aura and Light of Ruin recoil. Dragapult is Choice Scarf and currently locked into Flamethrower. Retain Primarina where possible as Basculegion and Fairy insurance.

decisions.rationale: Pult Scarf outspeeds sun Venu; sun Flame does 55-98% max into 90% Venu (~19% OHKO). Floette LoR (Fairy Aura) finishes almost always if Venu lives. Removing Chlorophyll LO Venu is the priority wincon; Protect is only 33%.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Mega ZardY Modest Drought (Protect-heavy); Venu Timid LO Chlorophyll Sleep Powder + beams; Chomp Scarf Jolly EQ-lock; Raichu Sash LR; H-Goodra Lefties Shell Armor; Prim EB Modest. Scarf EQ deletes Arc; sun beams punish Bascu. G1 Arc+Bascu failed into sun/sleep/Scarf Chomp. G2: bench Arc; Mega Floette+Maushold+Pult+Ape (Floette deletes Chomp/H-Goodra; Ape late Rage Fist). Registered sets unchanged.

decisions.rationale: Solar Beam is accurate and removes Floette before it can use its only super-effective listed attack into Primarina, regardless of the uncertain Floette–Charizard Speed order. Moonblast cleanly KOs Choice-Scarf Dragapult if it stays; Flamethrower is resisted by both actives. If Floette Protects, poison finishes it while Moonblast still removes Dragapult.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard to support Mega Floette or Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion. Basculegion has Aqua Jet. Mega Floette has Fairy Aura and Light of Ruin recoil. Dragapult is Choice Scarf and was locked into Flamethrower. Retain Primarina where possible as Basculegion and Fairy insurance.

decisions.rationale: Floette is at 1% psn and dies to residual even behind Protect, so Protect still pivots attacks while Pult exits a dead Flame lock. Flame does ~12-22% into either foe; Prim Moon OHKOes Pult. Ape in is the cleaner absorb and frees Choice.
Only Pult left; send into slot a vs Zard+Prim. Scarf outspeeds both; position arbitrary with one mon.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Mega ZardY Modest Drought (Protect-heavy); Venu Timid LO Chlorophyll Sleep Powder + beams; Chomp Scarf Jolly EQ-lock; Raichu Sash LR; H-Goodra Lefties Shell Armor; Prim EB Modest. Scarf EQ deletes Arc; sun beams punish Bascu. G1 Arc+Bascu failed into sun/sleep/Scarf Chomp. G2: bench Arc; Mega Floette+Maushold+Pult+Ape (Floette deletes Chomp/H-Goodra; Ape late Rage Fist). Registered sets unchanged. Pult alone endgame vs sun core.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult is Choice-locked into Flamethrower, which is resisted by Primarina. Primarina’s Expert Belt Moonblast is a guaranteed OHKO on Dragapult; Air Slash adds neutral chip in case it matters while avoiding resisted Fire/Grass attacks.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Dragapult is Choice Scarf Timid and was locked into Flamethrower after revealing it. Opponent used Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard support. Retain Primarina where possible as Basculegion and Fairy insurance.

decisions.rationale: Only Pult left vs full ZardY+Prima in sun. Scarf outspeeds both. Shadow Ball hits Prima SE (Fairy) and Zard neutral; Prima more immediate Moonblast/Ice threat and no Protect last turn. Draco immune on Prima, Flamethrower resisted both + sun helps little vs resists. Need chip both for eventual 1v1.

reflections.summary: Won because Mega Charizard Y’s sun pressure removed Maushold and enabled the endgame, while Primarina cleanly covered Annihilape and finished Choice Scarf Dragapult. Charizard Y was well suited to this matchup, but Venusaur was a disposable lead into Dragapult’s Flamethrower.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Mega Charizard Y, but next time consider leading Charizard Y + Primarina rather than Venusaur: it preserves Venusaur from Scarf Flamethrower and immediately maintains stronger Dragapult/Annihilape coverage.
reflections.notebook: Opponent has shown a Maushold + Mega Floette lead built around Follow Me/Friend Guard and Protect. Dragapult is Timid Choice Scarf and revealed Flamethrower and Shadow Ball; do not assume it remains locked into its previous move after switching targets/turns. Preserve Primarina as key insurance against Dragapult, Annihilape, and Basculegion. Against this support lead, Mega Charizard Y is a strong intended Mega; consider Charizard Y + Primarina lead over exposing Venusaur early.

reflections.summary: Lost because team preview was wrong: Mega Floette+Maushold into their ZardY+Venusaur sun core died immediately (Follow Me ate Heat Wave/Sludge; Floette poisoned/chipped), Primarina Moonblast deleted the Ape switch-in, and Scarf Pult alone could not beat ZardY+Prim.
reflections.adjustment: Do not lock Mega Floette+Maushold vs their Drought lead; preview a core that pressures ZardY/Primarina and keeps Ape off free Moonblast switches (bench Floette if they show sun+Prim again).
reflections.notebook: Opp: Mega ZardY Modest Drought Protect-heavy (Heat Wave/Solar Beam/Air Slash/Protect); Venu Timid LO Chlorophyll (Sludge Bomb/Solar Beam/Sleep Powder/Protect); Prim EB Modest (Moonblast/Hydro Pump/Ice Beam/Protect) pairs with sun; Chomp Scarf Jolly; Raichu Sash LR; H-Goodra Lefties Shell Armor. Sun+Prim brought G2; Protect on Zard stalls mega damage. G1 Arc+Bascu failed sun/sleep/Scarf Chomp. G2 Mega Floette+Maus+Pult+Ape failed vs sun+Prim (Floette Chomp/Goodra answer never relevant; Ape weak to Moonblast; Pult alone loses endgame). Registered sets unchanged. Avoid Floette mega vs Drought+Prim; need preview that contests sun without free Ape into Prim.
